## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting, linting, and strict typing pass
- [ ] Portable automated tests pass
- [ ] End-to-end verification passes or the skipped prerequisite is documented
- [ ] Native build and CTest pass when native code changed
- [ ] Safety, privacy, requirements, and examples are updated where relevant

## Evidence integrity

- [ ] Workloads remain bounded and cancellation-aware
- [ ] No identifying machine data or secrets are introduced
- [ ] Synthetic evidence is clearly labelled
